content:
Elaine CS: Heads-up — Peregrine Labs capacity bring-up next Tue 04/12. Need final quota numbers and autoscale thresholds so we can run soak + burst tests. Who's on it?
Sam SRE: I'm available for load tests. Need target RPS and percentile latency SLO. Can we get their expected steady and peak qps?
Marcus SE: Peregrine expects ~120 qps steady, 600 qps peak bursts (3x 15m). They want warm caches and a reserved pool of 8 GPUs. KMS rotation required on cutover.
Deepak Runtime: For 600 qps we'll want per-GPU batchsize 8, continuous batching on, and KV cache priming. Suggest autoscale min=4 max=12, cooldown=90s. Also prefer quant profile 'q4_0' for cost.
Elaine CS: Good notes. Can someone push a short smoke script so CS can trigger priming?
Deepak Runtime: Quick snippet below (make sure to set $TOKEN):
```
loadgen --target 600 --pattern burst:900s --concurrency 100 --auth $TOKEN --prompt-file peregrine_profile.json
```
Marcus SE: I'll upload the customer traffic profile and sample prompts tonight. I'll also share Anna (anna@peregrine) as the runtimes contact.
Sam SRE: Proposed runbook: 1) allocate reserved pool 8 GPUs, 2) apply autoscale policy (min=4,max=12,policy=latency-based), 3) priming: 30m at 50% steady, 4) controlled bursts 3x15m at 600qps, 5) observability: token-cost + p50/p95 + error-rate dashboards, 6) rollback plan -> fallback model.
Elaine CS: Flagging renewal risk: customer requires p50 < 50ms and p95 < 300ms. That's tight for their prompt lengths — want ops and runtime to confirm feasibility before sign-off.
Deepak Runtime: I'll prepare fallback model config (gpt-medium-quant) and an automatic-fallback trigger: if p95 > 450ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, switch route.
Marcus SE: Also note they want KMS key rotation window during cutover. Ops: can we schedule a brief KMS freeze?
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "peregrine-capacity-priming" - Tue 2024-04-12 08:00 UTC. Owner: Sam SRE.
Sam SRE: I'll run a dry-run on staging tomorrow EOD to validate scripts and dashboards. Will post artifacts and dashboards link.
Elaine CS: Can we reconvene Mon EOD for final sign-off and to confirm billing/quota updates?
All: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
